name: Audit Log
description: Structured JSON logging of every system decision. Each entry is an AuditEntry with timestamp, task_name, event_type, and details dict. Writes to a JSON-lines file (configurable path) in append-only mode — entries are never modified or deleted. Provides query methods for report generation: entries_by_task, entries_by_type, entries_in_range. Uses Python stdlib logging module configured with a custom JSON formatter for the dedicated 'apprentice.audit' logger. All datetimes are UTC. Sync log() method leverages stdlib logging's thread-safety. Query methods stream-read the JSONL file with per-line error handling, skipping corrupted lines with warnings.

types.name: EventType
types.description: Closed enumeration of the 9 auditable system event types. StrEnum — each variant's value is its snake_case name. No catch-all variant; unrecognized event strings must be rejected at validation time (fail-fast).

types.name: AuditEntry

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime string of when the event occurred. Serialized from datetime via default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(UTC). Stored as ISO 8601 string in JSON. Internal representation is datetime; type_ref is str for the serialized contract boundary.

validators.error_message: Timestamp must be a valid ISO 8601 UTC datetime string with +00:00 timezone suffix

fields.name: task_name
fields.description: Name of the task this event pertains to. Must be non-empty.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: The category of system event. Must be one of the 9 defined EventType variants.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Arbitrary key-value map of event-specific metadata. Common keys include: model_used (str), routing_reason (str), confidence_score (float), cost (float), phase_from (str), phase_to (str), budget_remaining (float), error_message (str). Values are JSON-serializable (str, int, float, bool, None, list, dict).

types.description: Immutable (frozen) Pydantic v2 BaseModel representing a single auditable system decision. ConfigDict(frozen=True). The timestamp defaults to datetime.now(UTC) via default_factory. Provides .to_json_line() -> str for JSONL serialization (compact JSON, no trailing newline).

types.name: AuditConfig

fields.name: log_path
fields.description: Filesystem path to the JSONL audit log file. Parent directory must exist and be writable at config validation time. The file itself will be created if it does not exist. Relative paths are resolved from the working directory.

validators.error_message: log_path must be a non-empty string
log_path parent directory must exist and be writable

types.description: Pydantic v2 BaseModel for audit logger configuration. Validated at startup — fail fast on invalid config. Typically loaded from the YAML config file's 'audit' section.

types.name: AuditLogger
types.description: Protocol (typing.Protocol) defining the abstract audit logging interface. All audit consumers depend on this protocol, not the concrete implementation. Four methods: log, entries_by_task, entries_by_type, entries_in_range. No delete/update/clear methods — append-only by design.

types.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger

fields.name: config
fields.description: Injected audit configuration. Validated and used to set up the file handler on construction.

types.description: Concrete implementation of AuditLogger. Uses stdlib logging module with a custom JSON formatter attached to a dedicated 'apprentice.audit' named logger. File handler opened in append mode. Accepts AuditConfig via constructor (dependency injection). Validates log_path on init. Query methods stream-read the JSONL file, deserializing each line into AuditEntry, skipping corrupted lines with a warning logged to the application logger. Thread-safe via stdlib logging internals.

types.name: AuditEntryList
types.description: A list of AuditEntry objects returned by query methods.

functions.name: AuditEntry.to_json_line
functions.description: Serialize this AuditEntry to a single-line compact JSON string suitable for appending to a JSONL file. Uses Pydantic's model_dump_json() with no indentation. Does not include a trailing newline character. The output is deterministic for a given entry (sorted keys).

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.__init__
functions.description: Construct a JsonLinesAuditLogger from an AuditConfig. Validates that log_path's parent directory exists and is writable. Creates the log file if it does not exist. Configures a dedicated stdlib logging.Logger named 'apprentice.audit' with a FileHandler in append mode and a custom JSON formatter. The logger is isolated — propagate=False, so audit entries do not leak to root or application loggers.

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.log
functions.description: Append a single AuditEntry to the audit log. Serializes the entry via to_json_line() and emits it through the stdlib 'apprentice.audit' logger, which writes to the configured JSONL file handler. Synchronous — blocks until the entry is flushed. Thread-safe via stdlib logging internals. This is the only write path; all mutations go through this method.

inputs.name: entry
inputs.description: The audit entry to append. Must be a valid, fully-constructed AuditEntry.

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.entries_by_task
functions.description: Query the audit log for all entries matching the given task_name. Stream-reads the JSONL file line by line, deserializing each into an AuditEntry and filtering by task_name equality (case-sensitive exact match). Corrupted or unparseable lines are skipped with a warning logged to the application logger (not the audit logger). Returns entries in chronological order (file order).

inputs.name: task_name
inputs.description: The task name to filter by. Case-sensitive exact match. Must be non-empty.

functions.name: JsonLinesAuditLogger.entries_in_range
functions.description: Query the audit log for all entries with timestamps in the range [start, end] (inclusive on both bounds). Stream-reads the JSONL file line by line, deserializing each into an AuditEntry and filtering by timestamp comparison. Both start and end must be timezone-aware UTC datetimes. Corrupted or unparseable lines are skipped with a warning logged to the application logger. Returns entries in chronological order (file order).

invariants: The audit log file is append-only: no entry, once written, is ever modified or deleted
All timestamps in audit entries are timezone-aware UTC datetimes
Every AuditEntry has a valid EventType from the closed 9-variant enum; no catch-all or unknown variant exists
The AuditEntry model is frozen (immutable) after construction
The 'apprentice.audit' logger is isolated (propagate=False) and does not emit to root or application loggers
Query methods never modify the audit log file

The details dict accepts dict[str, Any] values but all values must be JSON-serializable
